# rss-articles — fixtures for 載入全文 (`modules/rss/articleExtract.test.ts`)

Structure of ten kinds of article pages, trimmed to the markup that matters; every text is neutral filler
("Body paragraph one…"), never somebody's article. No network was available when these were written, so they come
from the documented default templates of each generator/theme (class names, nesting, element order), not from a
fetched copy of a live page. `hugo-post-main.html` follows the structure the owner reported on 2026-11-14.
